posts.title: Understanding American Football: From First Down to Cover 3
posts.description: The rules, the positions and the downs for someone who has never watched a game, then the run schemes, route trees and coverages for someone who has watched a thousand. Twenty-five things to click, and a game where you call the plays.

posts.title: Understanding Colour: From Three Numbers to a Whole Theme
posts.description: RGB, HSV, HSL, CMYK and OKLCH, what a colour wheel is actually for, and a theme generator that turns one colour into a full light and dark palette. Mostly things to drag.

posts.title: Teaching a Web Page to Read a Chess Board
posts.description: Finding a chess board in a screenshot, straightening it, and reading the position with a 130,565 parameter neural network that runs in plain JavaScript. As efficiently and lightweight as possible to achieve worthwhile accuracy.
